contexts.text: Laban gave her Zilpah his handmaid () = external affections, or external bonds, which are subservient means.
She took Zilpah her handmaid () = an affirmative medium conjoining.
And Zilpah the handmaid of Leah Lore a son to Jacob () = the acknowledgement of external truth. AC 3937.

The sons of Zilpah the handmaid of Leah; Gad, and Asher () = things subservient to exterior things; for Zilpah the handmaid of Leah = a sequent affection that is subservient to the affection of exterior truth as a medium (for conjunction).
These are the sons of Zilpah () = that these are of the external Church.
